knownDefects.detail: matlab-runner / matlab-orchestrator SKILL.md tells the agent to run .\scripts\Test-MatlabMcpExistingSession.ps1. Inside an installed project copy that path does not exist, so the client went looking for it and ended up reading the source repository working copy (scripts/* at the checkout root). The episode still passed, which is exactly why this is a latent defect: it works only where a clone happens to be reachable.
knownDefects.recommendation: Ship that check inside the Skill and reference it relative to SKILL.md. Not edited this phase: changing SKILL.md would move every installed hash while the install audit is still open, and a metadata edit needs before/after evidence of its own.
